configDir.title: Config directory
configDir.usingShared: Shares the wrapper's Claude Code directory with every other account, as before.
configDir.usingOwn: Claude Code runs for this account against {{dir}}.
configDir.pathHint: An absolute path. It is created empty if it does not exist. Nothing in your shared directory is moved or copied.
configDir.shareHint: Links settings.json, CLAUDE.md, keybindings.json, agents, commands and skills from the shared directory, without overwriting anything already there. The transcripts folder is always linked, so Agentry still finds this account's chats.
configDir.login: An account with its own directory needs its own login: run CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR={{dir}} claude once and sign in there. Agentry never copies credentials.
configDir.saved: {{name}} now has its own config directory
configDir.failed: The config directory could not be changed
configDir.resetBody: Only the links Agentry made are removed, and only while they still point where it left them. The directory and anything else in it stay.

policies.title: Rotation policies
policies.intro: Which accounts the chats of a project may use, in which order, and at what usage to move on to the next. A project with no policy keeps the global auto-rotation, and so does a chat you pinned to an account by hand.
policies.noneHint: Every project follows the global auto-rotation.
policies.projectsHint: A project has at most one policy.
policies.thresholdHint: A chat stays on its account until the account's binding window crosses this.
policies.orderHint: Add accounts to limit the policy to them, and order them. A chat takes the first one with room.
policies.addAccount: Add an account to the order
policies.saveFailed: The policy could not be saved
policies.deleteBody: Its projects go back to the global auto-rotation. Chats already running stay on their accounts.

history.title: Usage history
history.intro: How much of each rate-limit window an account used, from the readings Agentry keeps every few minutes while claude-swap is installed.
history.noneHint: Readings are taken every 5 minutes while the wrapper runs. A range from before the wrapper started has none.
history.chartTitle: Share of the rate-limit window used, over time
history.describeSeries: {{account}}: {{latest}}% now, at most {{peak}}% in the range.
history.table: Show the figures as a table
history.tableCaption: Usage readings per account in the chosen window and range
